thesis: A net-cash CGM leader with sharply rising returns and margins trades at the bottom of its own multiple range while in a healthy uptrend, with buybacks shrinking the share count.
reason: Scorecard gives conviction 4: top-tier and rising returns, net cash, and trend-strength valuation points with the price near the expected-value blend. Python sets the volatility-scaled size; cash cannot fund it above the 1.5% floor, so the conviction-3 OTIS holding is sold to fund it.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 25%, giving up most of the rise from 24.1% in FY2024 to 45.9%.
TTM gross margin falls below 58%, under the FY2025 low of 60.1%, signalling CGM price competition.
TTM operating margin falls below 18%, reversing the step-up from 17.2% a year earlier to 24.0%.
A new FDA warning letter, recall order or production shutdown disclosed in a 10-Q/8-K.

replacement_reason: OTIS is held at conviction 3 with a balanced rather than compelling skew, price above its mechanical fair value, falling operating margin and rising leverage (its own thesis); DXCM clears the buy bar at conviction 4 with rising returns and net cash, and cash cannot fund a full position above the 1.5% floor.
